t: You're looking at St. Stephen's, a Grade I listed building on Rosslyn Hill, at the junction with Pond Street, right beside the Royal Free Hospital. It's a former church, set on a steep slope, and at its peak it held up to twelve hundred worshippers. It takes its name from Saint Stephen, honoured as the first Christian martyr. According to the Acts of the Apostles, he was a deacon in Jerusalem who was stoned to death after a trial for blasphemy, with Saul, later Paul the Apostle, looking on.
